name: Kerala Sadya
description: A multi-course vegetarian feast served on a plantain leaf with up to 26 distinct dishes, culminating in velvety payasams.

name: Appam & Ishtu
tagline: Lacy Fermented Rice Crepes & Spiced Coconut Milk
description: Crispy-edged, fluffy-centered fermented rice pancakes paired with a fragrant, mildly spiced coconut milk stew of vegetables or tender chicken.

name: Malabar Parotta & Beef Roast
description: Legendary multi-layered, flaky flatbread paired with rich, slow-roasted beef or spicy coconut chicken curry with crispy fried coconut flakes.

name: Karimeen Pollichathu
tagline: Pearl Spot Fish Steamed in Plantain Leaf
description: Freshwater pearl spot fish marinated in shallots, ginger, garlic, and Kashmiri chili, wrapped in charred banana leaf and slow-cooked to perfection.

name: Puttu & Kadala Curry
tagline: Steamed Rice Cylinders with Black Chickpea Gravy
description: Steamed cylinders of coarsely ground rice flour layered with grated coconut, served with a fiery black chickpea and roasted coconut curry.

name: Pazham Pori & Sulaimani Chaya
tagline: Golden Banana Fritters with Spiced Black Tea
description: Ripe, sweet Nendran bananas dipped in golden batter and deep-fried, paired with a piping-hot glass of cardamom-mint spiced black tea.
